items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: I did it, like I told you, with a guy named Big Brown.

ctx.x: I have that talent, man, I don't know. I did it, like I told you, with a guy named Big Brown. It scared me, when I read it. It's like, a little spooky, ghostly.
It's like having perfect pitch for peoples' cadences and speech, I guess.
